audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Trundle (3/10) in both layers, while the page's own whys[4] and spikes[2] say his Subjugate drain-fight 'just feeds your buildings'. The packet chart also has Level 6 as Heimerdinger. Separately the entry is labelled diff FAV but rated 7.5/10 'Tricky' at a 62.2% win rate over 82 games.
audit.why: Trundle has no dash and no gap-closer, so at 6 UPGRADE!!! (100/85/70s) either entrenches a super-turret or widens the grenade — both of which punish the only approach he has. The difficulty rating contradicted the win rate, the chart and the FAV label.
audit.corrected: Level 6 goes to Heimerdinger at 6/10; overall difficulty 4/10, favourable.
sources: brief enemyKit (no dash in Trundle's kit)

audit.why: All four spikes are present and correctly ordered: turret two at 2-3, three charges plus the grenade at 4-5, UPGRADE!!! at 6, and Trundle's own drain-tank item window late. Only the grenade's name inside them was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid text, whys[3], spikes[1] and wants.you[1] all call Heimerdinger's grenade 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' / 'the CH-3X center-stun', and they describe the whole blast as stunning. Chomp's auto-attack reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's data names the E CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat cooldown, 970 range) and its text is explicit that it stuns only 'anyone directly hit', slowing the surrounding units. Chomp (Q, 3.5s) is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up — not the cast — is the burst tell.
audit.corrected: Name the grenade CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, state that only the direct hit stuns and the surround merely slows, and read Chomp's auto-reset wind-up as the cue to step back.

audit.why: Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) is already called for early against King's Tribute and Frozen Domain, and the page already warns that Subjugate strips resistances rather than being answered by them.
sources: brief missingInteractions rules needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated

edits.after: Chomp is an auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue. Subjugate steals resists for 4s.

edits.before: This is your stranglehold. With three banked turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade you wall the choke and dare him to commit — the instant he Chomps in, drop the center-stun on him and the whole nest plus W rockets shreds a stunned, immobile drain-tank. Remember Trundle has no gap-closer: Pillar of Ice only blocks terrain and Frozen Domain just buffs his stats, so he literally cannot reach you without walking through the beams and the grenade. At 6, UPGRADE!!! into a super-turret to zone him off the wave or a wider super-grenade for a longer stun — his Subjugate drain fight just feeds your buildings.
edits.after: This is your stranglehold. With three banked turret charges and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s) you wall the choke and dare him to commit — the instant Chomp's wind-up starts, land the grenade directly on him, because only the direct hit stuns and the surround just slows. Trundle has no gap-closer: Pillar of Ice only makes terrain and Frozen Domain just buffs his stats, so he cannot reach you without walking through the beams. At 6, UPGRADE!!! into a super-turret to zone him off the wave or a wider grenade for a longer stun — his Subjugate drain fight feeds your buildings.

notes: 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' was a fabricated ability name appearing in mid, whys[3], spikes[1] and wants.you[1]; Riot's only Heimerdinger grenade is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, and only its direct hit stuns. The mirror audit (trundle__heimerdinger) flagged the same fabrication, so a repo-wide sweep for 'CH-3X' across all heimerdinger matchups is worth running. Level 1 is left as Trundle in both layers even though the packet chart says Skill, because both layers already agree and the prose (Chomp AD-steal in melee range with one turret out) supports Trundle; changing it would fight consistent text on thin evidence.
